assessment: Verified the current app.ts, local-test-harness.ts, config.ts, and main.ts SHA-256 digests match the specified frozen candidate manifest.

Trade-update injection and inspection routes are registered only when localTestMode is enabled and a fixture-backed harness exists. Local-test configuration rejects Alpaca and OpenRouter credentials and requires loopback application and database hosts. Startup code avoids constructing live Alpaca adapters in local-test mode.

The route accepts bounded JSON bodies, validates a strict top-level/update schema, caps each batch at 20, validates all updates before mutation, and caps retained observations at 100. Errors do not echo payload data; local mode disables Fastify request logging, and the harness logs only accepted count and a fixed target/status.

Observations are returned as synthetic PAPER-marked hints, are kept separately from canonical account positions and open orders, are not included in persisted runtime snapshots, and are cleared by reset. Request-supplied order identifiers are exposed back only as caller-provided synthetic fixture data; no credential fields are accepted or logged.
